summary: Team and spike support. Graves brings crowd control and debuffs rather than raw ability damage: Grasping Hands immobilizes (1.75s at T3, 20s cooldown), Essence Theft steals 45% of the target's weapon damage and spirit resist (so it works for the whole team), Jar of Dead slows. Items extend that: healing and barriers for allies, spirit resist shred and spirit amp on targets, Heroic Aura for the team's fire rate, and cooldowns so the control is up more often. Survivability: barriers (Guardian Ward into Divine Barrier), Counterspell and Spirit Resilience; the build gives up damage to stay alive and keep allies alive.
